facts.fact: The national Data Center (600 m2, COREX) was officially launched on 4 September 2025, and the presidency's chief of cabinet said it is open to offering hosting services, including for other countries' data.

COREX's deputy director-general said the national Data Center is certified Tier 3 Design by Uptime Institute, with Tier 3 construction certification still to come; the article calls it the country's first Tier III data centre.
